name: Pinia
description: Pinia store organization conventions supported by official documentation.

rules.title: Define stores in separate files
rules.summary: Pinia recommends defining each store in a different file.

rules.title: Keep store-owned state inside the store abstraction
rules.summary: Store state, getters and actions should remain part of the store abstraction rather than exposing unrelated injected/router objects as store-owned state.

sources.title: Defining a Store | Pinia
sources.notes: Official Pinia v3 documentation recommends separate files for stores and documents store state/getter/action ownership.
